newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 endorses draft on rate risk management.
newsitem.headline: G10 endorses draft on rate risk management.

text.p: The Group of 10 (G10) central bank governors have endorsed a proposal on how banks should manage financial risks stemming from fluctuations in interest rates, Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said.

Tietmeyer, who is also chairman of the G10 central bank governors' committee, told reporters at the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) the draft would be forwarded to banks and their response was expected this summer.
The draft has been prepared by the Basle Committee on Banking Supervision, which groups G10 banking supervisors, and its chairman Tommaso Padoa-Schioppa briefed G10 central bankers on the proposal.
Tietmeyer said the G10 would again discuss the proposal following the response by the banks.
"This is a paper on interest rate risks and what should be done to control it," Tietmeyer said.
